summary: The issue reported that __repr__ does not escape newlines in text. Investigation revealed that Python's !r format specifier already correctly escapes newlines. The fix strengthens the weak test assertion in test_issue_2087_todo_repr.py and adds comprehensive new tests in test_issue_5943_repr_newline_escape.py to ensure the behavior is properly verified.
risks: No source code changes needed - the existing implementation using !r format specifier correctly escapes newlines. The changes are purely test improvements.
limitations: None - all acceptance criteria from the issue are met by the existing implementation.
